name: WPGen Forms – Creating WordPress Forms or Checklists with help of Generative AI ( Contact Form 7, WPForms, Forminator, Ninja Forms, Generative Forms, LLM, AI )
author: Gnanasekaran R

sections.description:
WPGen Forms using the LLM to simplify the forms creation process in popular WordPress plugins such as CF7, WPForms, Ninja Forms and etc..

Don’t need a fancy form builder to create forms for WordPress. Instead, use the WPGen Forms to generate forms using AI. With the prompting, users can quickly generate customized forms or checklists.

It’s a powerful tool that can help you create a wide range of forms, from basic contact forms to complex multi-step surveys.

Form Generative plugin (Forms AI) to create WordPress forms like contact form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms and etc…

With help of this plugin, you can create WordPress forms or checklists with the given prompt. This plugin uses OpenAI and groq services to generate forms. You can create forms easily and with in sec.

⏩ Use of 3rd Party Services

To improve the user experience and to provide the best service, WPGen Forms uses the following services.

  • OpenAI: To generate forms by given prompt. OpenAI TOS and Privacy Policy
  • Groq: To generate forms by given prompt. Groq TOS and Privacy Policy

Features

  • Create WordPress forms or checklists with the help of Generative AI
  • It does support Contact Form 7
  • It does support wpforms
  • It does support Ninja Forms
  • It does support Forminator

Create Forms using LLM (Large Language Model)

Powered by advanced natural language processing, WPGen Forms interprets user prompts to create forms that meet specific requirements. Whether it’s a basic contact form or a complex multi-step survey, the plugin handles the heavy lifting, allowing users to focus on their content.

Full Compatibility with your favourite WordPress form plugins

WPGen Forms seamlessly integrates with Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms and Forminator, etc. This ensures that users can continue using their preferred plugins while benefiting from the enhanced capabilities offered by WPGen Forms.

Benefits

Time-Saving

WPGen Forms eliminates the need for manual form creation, saving users time and effort. By leveraging LLM, the plugin streamlines the form-building process, allowing users to generate forms quickly and efficiently.

Enhanced User Experience

With WPGen Forms, users can create forms that are tailored to their specific needs. By providing detailed prompts, users can generate forms that align with their goals, resulting in a more engaging and user-friendly experience for their audience.

User-Friendly Interface

WPGen Forms features a user-friendly interface that makes it easy to create forms. With intuitive controls and clear instructions, users can generate forms with minimal effort, even if they have limited technical expertise.

Cost-Effective

WPGen Forms offers a cost-effective solution for creating forms or checklists. Can generate forms without the need for expensive development resources, making it an affordable option for businesses of all sizes.

Other Upcoming Features

  • More form types
  • More form plugins support

Use Cases

Business and Corporate

Quickly generate professional contact forms, client intake forms, and feedback surveys that reflect your brand’s image.

E-commerce

Create custom order forms, product feedback surveys, and customer satisfaction questionnaires to enhance your online store’s user experience.

Blogging and Content Creation

Generate engaging feedback forms, reader surveys, and content submission forms to interact with your audience and gather valuable insights.

Healthcare and Wellness

Develop patient intake forms, appointment scheduling forms, and health assessment surveys to streamline your practice’s operations.

Education and Training

Create course registration forms, student feedback surveys, and training evaluation forms to enhance your educational programs.

Hotel

Generate booking forms, guest feedback surveys, and event registration forms to improve your hotel’s guest experience.

Real Estate

Develop property inquiry forms, client feedback surveys, and open house registration forms to streamline your real estate business.

Nonprofit and Community

Generate registration forms, speaker application forms, and post-event surveys to streamline event management.
sections.installation:
1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the WPGen Forms plugin settings page and update the openAI API key (Get it from openAI).
  4. Then, go to the dashboard and click the “Add New Form by Generative AI” button.
  5. Define the prompt of the form you want to create. And, click the “Generate Form” action button.
  6. Processing is done, you will get message like “Form generated successfully”.
  7. Tada!. Form is generated successfully. You can see the generated form in the plugin form list.
